reviews.title: Quality is first-rate and at a nice price-point, but ...
reviews.comment: Pros: Quality is very good.  Covers on both sides, front and top easily remove without tools leaving an open framework.  Ample space for a graphics card at the front of the case. Cons: Space is very tight, especially if your MB is ATX and has traditional top-mounted connections.  Instructions are limited as with a lot of other cases.  Power and reset buttons are mounted at the bottom front and could be tripped with a foot.  USB ports are likewise at the bottom on the side and requires a stretch to bend over if the case is sitting on the floor.  Control of the case RGB lighting is less than straightforward.  Cooling with fans only will require purchasing an additional fan and mounting it in a "cage" that attaches to the rear of the case. Summary: Best for bottom connection motherboards, especially smaller sizes, with water cooling and separate graphics card.  I could not get the case RGB lights to operates according to the instructions (and after looking online) and finally just disconnected the power.
reviews.author: Sunny Daze

reviews.title: Compact yet heavy
reviews.comment: The layout in the case is uncommon but works out better than it seems. Space in the rear behind the motherboard is limited but there's enough clearance for cables and airflow from the sides. Lighting looks great with the integrated light strip and the front panel cables have good length plus match the case's color. The included fans are simple with no lighting but are high quality with good airflow. Performance wise, there's enough airflow and most of it will exhaust from the right side (mesh panel). I have had no issues with video card temperatures and my AMD Ryzen 9 7950X does not throttle with a 360 AIO.
reviews.author: Eric

reviews.title: Great case
reviews.comment: I bought this case to build a PC using spare parts I had lying around for casual couch gaming. The case looks great, features an interesting layout, and was very easy to build in. I would recommend using a low-profile CPU cooler, as the AMD Wraith Prism is too tall to fit properly.
